response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and platforms, but his background is heavily skewed toward web, mobile, and scripting languages (TypeScript, Node.js, React, etc.) rather than C++ or industrial automation. His recent roles focus on full-stack development, AI infrastructure, and open-source projects, with minimal demonstrated expertise in C++-driven industrial automation, secure development lifecycle, or cloud-native solutions like Azure. While he shows strong problem-solving and collaboration skills, the lack of alignment with core technical competencies (e.g., C++ STL, multi-threading, IEC 62443) and minimal exposure to industrial automation protocols (Modbus, OPC UA) significantly reduces his fit for this role.
strengths: Strong full-stack development experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and React
Proven track record in open-source contributions and tech community engagement
Experience with low-latency systems and asynchronous programming (D, JavaScript) in high-scale environments
concerns: Limited or no experience with C++ in industrial automation or high-performance systems
No demonstrated knowledge of IEC 62443, secure coding standards, or industrial cybersecurity
Minimal exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., Azure) or IoT protocols (MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus TCP/IP)

key_factors.factor: Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) and IEC 62443 compliance
